title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
summary: 從單元板塊的風壓與自重傳遞路徑出發，計算錨件反力、樓板撓度與層間變位對上下單元接縫的需求，說明公母豎框、預埋槽與三向調整錨件的設計，再處理樓層吊運、安裝順序、公差吸收與性能樣品牆的層間位移試驗，最後以斷熱、排水、結露與維護更換完成交接，並以哈里發塔、世界貿易中心一號大樓與碎片大廈的公開資料說明超高層立面的尺度。
summaryEn: Starting from how wind and self-weight travel through a unit, calculate anchor reactions and the demands that slab deflection and interstorey drift place on the stack joint, explain split mullions, cast-in channels and three-way adjustable brackets, then cover floor-by-floor logistics, installation sequence, tolerance absorption and racking tests on the performance mock-up, and close with thermal breaks, drainage, condensation and maintenance, using public information on Burj Khalifa, One World Trade Center and The Shard to show the scale of supertall façades.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 60 層辦公塔標準層周長 120 m、層高 4.2 m，採 1.5 m 寬單元，標準區設計風壓 3.0 kPa、角隅區 4.5 kPa。每層 120/1.5 = 80 片，共 4,800 片。標準區每單元風力 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每錨件 9.45 kN；角隅區為 4.5×1.5×4.2 = 28.35 kN，每錨件約 14.2 kN，乘 1.5 為 21.3 kN。豎框：標準區 w = 4.5 kN/m，L/175 = 24 mm 需 I ≥ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴；角隅區 w = 6.75 kN/m，需 I 按比例增為約 1.63×10⁷ mm⁴，即增加 50%。接縫變位預算 18.8 mm，設計 ±20 mm；層間位移試驗 1.5×21 = 31.5 mm。公差組合 √(25² + 10² + 5²) ≈ 27.4 mm，在 ±30 mm 調整量內。若安裝速率每日 40 片，約 120 個工作天。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 60-storey office tower has a 120 m typical-floor perimeter and 4.2 m storeys, using 1.5 m units with design pressures of 3.0 kPa in typical zones and 4.5 kPa at corners. Each floor needs 120/1.5 = 80 units, 4,800 in total. A typical unit takes 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN of wind, 9.45 kN per anchor; a corner unit takes 4.5×1.5×4.2 = 28.35 kN, about 14.2 kN per anchor or 21.3 kN with a 1.5 factor. Mullions: in typical zones w = 4.5 kN/m and L/175 = 24 mm requires I ≥ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴; at corners w = 6.75 kN/m, so I rises proportionally to about 1.63×10⁷ mm⁴, 50% more. The stack-joint movement budget is 18.8 mm, designed as ±20 mm, and the racking test uses 1.5×21 = 31.5 mm. Combined tolerance √(25² + 10² + 5²) ≈ 27.4 mm lies within the ±30 mm adjustment. At 40 units per day installation takes about 120 working days. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」與「層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓板邊緣錨件反力」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slab-edge anchor reaction” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 單元式帷幕牆把玻璃、鋁框、層間板與密封在工廠組成一層樓高、一個模數寬的板塊，現場只需掛上錨件並與相鄰單元插接。風壓由玻璃傳到豎框，豎框像跨越一層樓的簡支梁，上端反力經錨件進入樓板邊緣，下端反力經上下單元接縫傳給下一個單元的頂部，再由同一組錨件承受。自重則由每層錨件直接吊掛，並因板塊外移於樓板邊緣而產生偏心彎矩。設計時必須把每一層錨件的水平與垂直反力交給主結構設計者，納入樓板邊緣與邊梁的設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓板邊緣錨件反力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A unitized curtain wall assembles glass, aluminium framing, spandrel panels and seals in the factory into panels one storey high and one module wide, so on site each unit only needs to be hooked onto its anchors and interlocked with its neighbours. Wind passes from the glass to the mullions, which act as simple beams spanning one storey: the top reaction goes through the anchor into the slab edge, while the bottom reaction passes through the stack joint into the head of the unit below and on to the same anchors. Self-weight hangs directly from each floor's anchors and, because the unit sits outboard of the slab edge, creates an eccentric moment. Each floor's horizontal and vertical anchor reactions must be handed to the structural engineer for the design of the slab edge and edge beams. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Slab-edge anchor reaction” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單元 1.5 m × 4.2 m、設計風壓 q = 3.0 kPa：每單元風力 = 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每層兩個錨件各約 9.45 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 1.5 m × 4.2 m unit at design pressure q = 3.0 kPa, the wind on each unit is 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN, about 9.45 kN at each of the two anchors per floor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Slab-edge anchor reaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slab-edge anchor reaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單元 1.5 m × 4.2 m、設計風壓 q = 3.0 kPa：每單元風力 = 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每層兩個錨件各約 9.45 kN。單元面重 50 kg/m²，重 1.5×4.2×50 = 315 kg ≈ 3.09 kN；偏心 150 mm 時彎矩 ≈ 3.09×0.15 ≈ 0.46 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 1.5 m × 4.2 m unit at design pressure q = 3.0 kPa, the wind on each unit is 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN, about 9.45 kN at each of the two anchors per floor. At 50 kg/m² the unit weighs 1.5×4.2×50 = 315 kg ≈ 3.09 kN; with 150 mm eccentricity the moment is about 3.09×0.15 ≈ 0.46 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受；風壓應以風洞試驗或規範的局部外壓係數為依據，角隅區通常明顯較高。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them; pressures should come from wind-tunnel testing or code local cladding coefficients, and corner zones are usually much higher.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板邊緣錨件反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slab-edge anchor reaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受；風壓應以風洞試驗或規範的局部外壓係數為依據，角隅區通常明顯較高。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them; pressures should come from wind-tunnel testing or code local cladding coefficients, and corner zones are usually much higher. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：介面協調時以「錨件反力表」作為正式交付文件，標明荷重組合、作用點與偏心，並約定任何單元尺寸或風壓分區變更都要重新發出反力表，由結構設計者確認後才可施作預埋件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the anchor-reaction table a formal deliverable at interface coordination, stating load combinations, points of application and eccentricities, and agree that any change of unit size or wind zone triggers a reissued table, confirmed by the structural engineer before embeds are cast.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon; if the eccentric dead load is never passed to the structural engineer, cantilevered slab edges sag over time and squeeze the stack joints until they leak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 介面協調時以「錨件反力表」作為正式交付文件，標明荷重組合、作用點與偏心，並約定任何單元尺寸或風壓分區變更都要重新發出反力表，由結構設計者確認後才可施作預埋件。
knowledge.textEn: Make the anchor-reaction table a formal deliverable at interface coordination, stating load combinations, points of application and eccentricities, and agree that any change of unit size or wind zone triggers a reissued table, confirmed by the structural engineer before embeds are cast.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Unit load path and anchor reactions"?
options: 以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
錨件螺栓只要鎖緊，扭力值高低並不重要。
optionsEn: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
As long as bracket bolts are tight, the torque value does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以帷幕牆結構計算書列出各區（一般區、角隅區、頂部）的設計風壓、單元尺寸與錨件反力表，並由主結構設計者書面確認樓板邊緣、邊梁與預埋件能承受；風壓應以風洞試驗或規範的局部外壓係數為依據，角隅區通常明顯較高。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List in the façade structural calculations the design pressure, unit size and anchor reactions for each zone (typical, corner, top), and have the structural engineer confirm in writing that slab edges, edge beams and embeds can take them; pressures should come from wind-tunnel testing or code local cladding coefficients, and corner zones are usually much higher. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unit load path and anchor reactions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slab-edge anchor reaction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon; if the eccentric dead load is never passed to the structural engineer, cantilevered slab edges sag over time and squeeze the stack joints until they leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計時必須把每一層錨件的水平與垂直反力交給主結構設計者，納入樓板邊緣與邊梁的設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each floor's horizontal and vertical anchor reactions must be handed to the structural engineer for the design of the slab edge and edge beams.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆只是外裝飾，它的荷重對主結構可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unit load path and anchor reactions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只用一般區風壓設計全部錨件，角隅區單元在颱風中可能拉脫錨件或使豎框過度變形；未把偏心自重交給結構設計者，懸臂樓板邊緣長期下垂，上下單元接縫被擠壓而漏水。
只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon.
With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement.

quiz.explanationEn: Designing all anchors for the typical-zone pressure lets corner units pull out their anchors or over-deflect their mullions in a typhoon; if the eccentric dead load is never passed to the structural engineer, cantilevered slab edges sag over time and squeeze the stack joints until they leak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Interstorey drift, slab deflection and the stack joint: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「上下單元接縫」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stack joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每一層的單元在水平接縫處以公母型材互相插接，形成「上下單元接縫」。它必須同時做到防水、氣密與允許變位：樓板在活載重下撓曲、柱與核心筒長期縮短、鋁框隨溫度伸縮，都使上下單元的間距改變；地震或強風造成的層間變位則讓上下樓層水平錯動。單元式系統的優勢在於每個單元可在接縫處滑動或轉動，而不是讓玻璃本身受剪；但接縫的伸縮量若估計不足，密封條會被擠出或拉開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「上下單元接縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Units at each floor interlock at the horizontal joint through male and female profiles, forming the stack joint. It must be watertight and airtight while allowing movement: slab deflection under live load, long-term shortening of columns and core, and thermal movement of the aluminium all change the gap between units, and interstorey drift from earthquakes or strong wind shifts one floor sideways relative to the next. The advantage of a unitized system is that each unit can slide or rotate at the joints instead of shearing the glass; but if the joint's movement range is underestimated, the seals are squeezed out or pulled apart. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stack joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：垂直變位預算：樓板邊緣差異撓度 10 mm＋鋁豎框溫度伸縮 ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm＋柱與核心差異縮短 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm，接縫設計行程取 ±20 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vertical movement budget: differential slab-edge deflection 10 mm + aluminium mullion thermal movement ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm + differential shortening of columns and core 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm, so the joint is designed for ±20 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「上下單元接縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stack joint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Interstorey drift, slab deflection and the stack joint" is correct?
options: 只要密封膠夠好，上下單元接縫不需要預留變位行程。
鋁豎框只要應力低於容許值，撓度就不必另外檢查。
每一層的單元在水平接縫處以公母型材互相插接，形成「上下單元接縫」。
optionsEn: With good enough sealant, the stack joint needs no allowance for movement.
If an aluminium mullion's stress is below the allowable value, its deflection need not be checked.
Units at each floor interlock at the horizontal joint through male and female profiles, forming the stack joint.

quiz.explanationEn: Units at each floor interlock at the horizontal joint through male and female profiles, forming the stack joint. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interstorey drift, slab deflection and the stack joint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上下單元接縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stack joint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：垂直變位預算：樓板邊緣差異撓度 10 mm＋鋁豎框溫度伸縮 ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm＋柱與核心差異縮短 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm，接縫設計行程取 ±20 mm。水平層間變位 H/400 = 4,200/400 = 10.5 mm，由單元在接縫處側向滑動吸收。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vertical movement budget: differential slab-edge deflection 10 mm + aluminium mullion thermal movement ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm + differential shortening of columns and core 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm, so the joint is designed for ±20 mm. Horizontal interstorey drift H/400 = 4,200/400 = 10.5 mm is absorbed by units sliding sideways at the joints. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：向結構設計者取得各層樓板邊緣撓度、施工後長期縮短與設計層間變位的數值，逐項加總為變位預算；以性能樣品牆的層間位移試驗確認接縫在設計位移下不脫開、不漏水，並在安裝紀錄中量測每條接縫的初始間隙是否位於設計值中央。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain from the structural engineer each floor's slab-edge deflection, post-installation long-term shortening and design drift, and add them into a movement budget; confirm by racking tests on the performance mock-up that the joint neither disengages nor leaks at design movement, and record each joint's initial gap at installation to check that it sits near the middle of its range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Horizontal interstorey drift H/400 = 4,200/400 = 10.5 mm is absorbed by units sliding sideways at the joints. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Interstorey drift, slab deflection and the stack joint", which statement holds?
options: 垂直變位預算：樓板邊緣差異撓度 10 mm＋鋁豎框溫度伸縮 ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm＋柱與核心差異縮短 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm，接縫設計行程取 ±20 mm。
單元式帷幕牆在工廠完成，現場安裝不需要品質管制。
單元式帷幕牆的接縫可以滑動，因此不需要做層間位移試驗。
optionsEn: Vertical movement budget: differential slab-edge deflection 10 mm + aluminium mullion thermal movement ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm + differential shortening of columns and core 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm, so the joint is designed for ±20 mm.
Because units are made in the factory, site installation needs no quality control.

quiz.explanationEn: Vertical movement budget: differential slab-edge deflection 10 mm + aluminium mullion thermal movement ΔL = 23×10⁻⁶×4,200×60 ≈ 5.8 mm + differential shortening of columns and core 3 mm ≈ 18.8 mm, so the joint is designed for ±20 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 層間變位、樓板撓度與上下單元接縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interstorey drift, slab deflection and the stack joint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上下單元接縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stack joint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 向結構設計者取得各層樓板邊緣撓度、施工後長期縮短與設計層間變位的數值，逐項加總為變位預算；以性能樣品牆的層間位移試驗確認接縫在設計位移下不脫開、不漏水，並在安裝紀錄中量測每條接縫的初始間隙是否位於設計值中央。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain from the structural engineer each floor's slab-edge deflection, post-installation long-term shortening and design drift, and add them into a movement budget; confirm by racking tests on the performance mock-up that the joint neither disengages nor leaks at design movement, and record each joint's initial gap at installation to check that it sits near the middle of its range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：變位預算表應列為帷幕牆與結構雙方簽認的介面文件；安裝時每層抽量接縫初始間隙，偏離中心超過預定值即停止並調整錨件高度，避免把誤差累積到上方樓層。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The movement budget should be an interface document signed by both the façade and structural teams; during installation spot-check each floor's initial joint gaps and stop to adjust anchor heights if any deviates from centre by more than the agreed amount, so errors are not carried up the building.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未計入核心筒長期縮短的超高層，在完工數年後上下單元接縫逐漸閉合，密封條被擠出、玻璃角隅受壓破裂；初始間隙安裝在行程一端的接縫，第一次大位移就被拉開而漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In a supertall tower that ignored long-term core shortening, stack joints gradually close in the years after completion, squeezing out seals and cracking glass corners; joints installed at one end of their range are pulled open by the first large movement and leak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instructionEn: In a supertall tower that ignored long-term core shortening, stack joints gradually close in the years after completion, squeezing out seals and cracking glass corners; joints installed at one end of their range are pulled open by the first large movement and leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 公母豎框斷面與撓度控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Split-mullion sections and deflection control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「公母豎框鋁擠型」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Split male–female mullions” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 單元式帷幕牆的豎框由相鄰兩個單元各自的半支豎框（公框與母框）插接而成，兩半之間有密封條與間隙，使單元能獨立安裝與更換。風壓下兩半支豎框各自承擔一部分彎矩，若插接處沒有可靠的共同作用，應以兩者慣性矩相加、而非組合斷面來計算。鋁的彈性模數約為鋼的三分之一，因此豎框斷面通常由撓度而非強度控制；撓度過大會使玻璃邊緣轉動、密封條受拉，並讓室內人員感受到牆面「鼓動」。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「公母豎框鋁擠型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The mullion of a unitized wall is formed by two half-mullions, male and female, one from each adjacent unit, interlocked with gaskets and a gap so that units can be installed and replaced independently. Under wind each half carries part of the moment, and unless the interlock reliably acts compositely, the stiffness should be taken as the sum of the two inertias rather than a combined section. Aluminium has about one third of the stiffness of steel, so mullion sections are usually governed by deflection rather than strength; excessive deflection rotates glass edges, stretches gaskets and lets occupants feel the wall pumping. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Split male–female mullions” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：豎框分擔寬度 1.5 m、q = 3.0 kPa，w = 4.5 kN/m；跨度 4.2 m，M = wL²/8 = 4.5×4.2²/8 ≈ 9.92 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a tributary width of 1.5 m and q = 3.0 kPa, w = 4.5 kN/m; over a 4.2 m span M = wL²/8 = 4.5×4.2²/8 ≈ 9.92 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋁豎框只要應力低於容許值，撓度就不必另外檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If an aluminium mullion's stress is below the allowable value, its deflection need not be checked." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「公母豎框鋁擠型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 公母豎框斷面與撓度控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Split-mullion sections and deflection control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「公母豎框鋁擠型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Split male–female mullions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：豎框分擔寬度 1.5 m、q = 3.0 kPa，w = 4.5 kN/m；跨度 4.2 m，M = wL²/8 = 4.5×4.2²/8 ≈ 9.92 kN·m。撓度限制 L/175 = 24 mm，所需公母框合計慣性矩 I ≥ 5wL⁴/(384E·δ) = 5×4.5×4,200⁴/(384×70,000×24) ≈ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴（約 1,085 cm⁴）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a tributary width of 1.5 m and q = 3.0 kPa, w = 4.5 kN/m; over a 4.2 m span M = wL²/8 = 4.5×4.2²/8 ≈ 9.92 kN·m. With a deflection limit of L/175 = 24 mm, the combined male and female inertia must be I ≥ 5wL⁴/(384E·δ) = 5×4.5×4,200⁴/(384×70,000×24) ≈ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴ (about 1,085 cm⁴). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以鋁擠型的實際斷面性質（扣除斷熱條的貢獻或依試驗取用組合效應）計算撓度與應力，檢查鋁合金回火等級的容許應力；性能樣品牆的結構試驗中在豎框中央設位移計，比較設計風壓下的實測撓度與計算值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute deflection and stress from the actual extrusion properties, excluding the thermal-break contribution unless composite action is proven by test, and check the allowable stress for the alloy temper; in the mock-up structural test place displacement gauges at mullion mid-span and compare measured deflection at design pressure with the calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 說明「預埋槽與三向調整錨件」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cast-in channel and three-way bracket” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 單元板塊透過樓板邊緣的錨件就位。錨件通常由預埋在混凝土內的錨定槽、可調的鋼或鋁托架與單元頂部的掛鉤組成，提供進出、左右與上下三個方向的調整，以吸收樓板邊緣位置的施工誤差。預埋槽必須在澆置混凝土前精準定位，邊距、間距與鋼筋衝突都會降低拉拔承載。鋁與鋼接觸時，在潮濕環境下會產生電位腐蝕，因此要以絕緣墊片、塗層或不鏽鋼螺栓隔離。哈里發塔的 CTBUH 資料亦列出預埋槽與錨固系統供應商，說明這類元件在超高層立面的關鍵地位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預埋槽與三向調整錨件」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Units are seated on brackets at the slab edge. A bracket typically consists of an anchor channel cast into the concrete, an adjustable steel or aluminium bracket and the hook at the head of the unit, providing in–out, left–right and up–down adjustment to absorb construction errors in slab-edge position. The channel must be set accurately before the concrete pour, since edge distance, spacing and clashes with reinforcement all reduce pull-out capacity. Aluminium in contact with steel in damp conditions suffers galvanic corrosion, so isolating pads, coatings or stainless fasteners are used. The CTBUH record for Burj Khalifa lists anchor-channel and fixing suppliers, showing how central these components are to supertall façades. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cast-in channel and three-way bracket” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風吸時每錨件拉力 9.45 kN，乘荷重係數 1.5 為 14.2 kN；自重偏心彎矩 0.46 kN·m 若由兩個錨件的螺栓以 80 mm 力臂抵抗，每錨件附加拉力約 0.46/0.08/2 ≈ 2.9 kN，合計約 17.1 kN，須小於預埋槽在該邊距下的設計拉拔承載。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨件的調整範圍越大越好，可以吸收任何樓板誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 預埋槽、錨件與異種金屬隔離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cast-in channels, brackets and dissimilar-metal isolation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預埋槽與三向調整錨件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cast-in channel and three-way bracket” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前由測量員依控制網放樣檢查每支預埋槽的位置、高程與方向，並與鋼筋綁紮比對；澆置後抽樣做現場拉拔試驗確認承載；錨件安裝時檢查絕緣墊片、螺栓材質與防鬆措施，並拍照紀錄每一層的完成狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the pour have surveyors check each channel's position, level and orientation from the control network and against the reinforcement; after the pour carry out sample pull-out tests to confirm capacity; at bracket installation check isolating pads, bolt material and locking measures, and photograph each floor's completed condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預埋件放樣與檢查應列為混凝土澆置前的停止點，由帷幕牆廠商與結構監造共同簽認；遺漏或偏位的預埋槽只能以經設計核可的後置錨栓替代，並須做拉拔試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make embed setting-out and inspection a hold point before each pour, signed jointly by the façade contractor and the structural supervisor; missing or misplaced channels may be replaced only by design-approved post-installed anchors, with pull-out tests.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預埋槽被振動棒擠歪或與鋼筋衝突而被移位，邊距不足造成混凝土錐體拉破；若漏裝絕緣墊片，沿海高樓數年後鋁托架與鋼件接觸處腐蝕，錨件鬆動而單元下沉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Channels pushed askew by vibrators or displaced by clashes with reinforcement end up with too little edge distance and fail by concrete cone breakout; if isolating pads are omitted, a coastal tower sees aluminium brackets corrode at steel contacts within a few years, loosening anchors and letting units drop. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預埋件放樣與檢查應列為混凝土澆置前的停止點，由帷幕牆廠商與結構監造共同簽認；遺漏或偏位的預埋槽只能以經設計核可的後置錨栓替代，並須做拉拔試驗。

quiz.question: 要驗證「預埋槽、錨件與異種金屬隔離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cast-in channels, brackets and dissimilar-metal isolation"?

A curtain wall is just cladding, so its loads on the main structure can be ignored.

quiz.explanationEn: Before the pour have surveyors check each channel's position, level and orientation from the control network and against the reinforcement; after the pour carry out sample pull-out tests to confirm capacity; at bracket installation check isolating pads, bolt material and locking measures, and photograph each floor's completed condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預埋槽、錨件與異種金屬隔離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cast-in channels, brackets and dissimilar-metal isolation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預埋槽與三向調整錨件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cast-in channel and three-way bracket” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預埋槽被振動棒擠歪或與鋼筋衝突而被移位，邊距不足造成混凝土錐體拉破；若漏裝絕緣墊片，沿海高樓數年後鋁托架與鋼件接觸處腐蝕，錨件鬆動而單元下沉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Channels pushed askew by vibrators or displaced by clashes with reinforcement end up with too little edge distance and fail by concrete cone breakout; if isolating pads are omitted, a coastal tower sees aluminium brackets corrode at steel contacts within a few years, loosening anchors and letting units drop. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔的 CTBUH 資料亦列出預埋槽與錨固系統供應商，說明這類元件在超高層立面的關鍵地位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The CTBUH record for Burj Khalifa lists anchor-channel and fixing suppliers, showing how central these components are to supertall façades.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨件的調整範圍越大越好，可以吸收任何樓板誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The bigger the bracket adjustment range, the better, since it can absorb any slab error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 預埋槽被振動棒擠歪或與鋼筋衝突而被移位，邊距不足造成混凝土錐體拉破；若漏裝絕緣墊片，沿海高樓數年後鋁托架與鋼件接觸處腐蝕，錨件鬆動而單元下沉。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預埋槽、錨件與異種金屬隔離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cast-in channels, brackets and dissimilar-metal isolation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
預埋槽被振動棒擠歪或與鋼筋衝突而被移位，邊距不足造成混凝土錐體拉破；若漏裝絕緣墊片，沿海高樓數年後鋁托架與鋼件接觸處腐蝕，錨件鬆動而單元下沉。
單元式帷幕牆在工廠完成，現場安裝不需要品質管制。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Channels pushed askew by vibrators or displaced by clashes with reinforcement end up with too little edge distance and fail by concrete cone breakout.
Because units are made in the factory, site installation needs no quality control.
quiz.explanation: 預埋槽被振動棒擠歪或與鋼筋衝突而被移位，邊距不足造成混凝土錐體拉破；若漏裝絕緣墊片，沿海高樓數年後鋁托架與鋼件接觸處腐蝕，錨件鬆動而單元下沉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Channels pushed askew by vibrators or displaced by clashes with reinforcement end up with too little edge distance and fail by concrete cone breakout; if isolating pads are omitted, a coastal tower sees aluminium brackets corrode at steel contacts within a few years, loosening anchors and letting units drop. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏」與「現場測量與公差吸收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate" and "Site survey and tolerance absorption": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓層吊運與安裝節奏」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor logistics and installation rate” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 單元式系統把大部分工作移到工廠：玻璃安裝、結構矽利康固化、密封與品質檢查都在可控環境完成，現場只剩吊運、掛接與接縫密封。施工時單元以工地升降機或塔吊送到樓層暫存，再以樓上的單軌吊車、小型吊機或專用安裝機從外側掛上錨件，通常由下往上、緊跟在主結構之後數層進行。安裝高度越高，風速越大、可作業時間越短；哈里發塔官方資料即記錄其鋁與玻璃立面在 512 m 高度安裝，創下當時紀錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓層吊運與安裝節奏」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A unitized system moves most work into the factory: glazing, structural silicone curing, sealing and quality checks happen in controlled conditions, leaving only hoisting, hooking on and joint sealing for site. Units travel by hoist or tower crane to temporary storage on each floor, then a monorail, mini-crane or dedicated installer on the floor above lowers them onto their anchors from outside, usually working upward a few floors behind the structure. The higher the installation, the stronger the wind and the shorter the working window; Burj Khalifa's official information records the installation of its aluminium and glass façade at a height of 512 m as a record. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Floor logistics and installation rate” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：標準層周長 120 m、單元寬 1.5 m，每層 120/1.5 = 80 片；60 層共 4,800 片。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A typical floor with a 120 m perimeter and 1.5 m units needs 120/1.5 = 80 units; 60 floors need 4,800.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單元式帷幕牆在工廠完成，現場安裝不需要品質管制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because units are made in the factory, site installation needs no quality control." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓層吊運與安裝節奏」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Floor logistics and installation rate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：單元式帷幕牆在工廠完成，現場安裝不需要品質管制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate" is correct?
options: 單元式帷幕牆在工廠完成，現場安裝不需要品質管制。
只要每一片單元都對齊下面那一片，整面帷幕牆就一定垂直。
單元式系統把大部分工作移到工廠：玻璃安裝、結構矽利康固化、密封與品質檢查都在可控環境完成，現場只剩吊運、掛接與接縫密封。
optionsEn: Because units are made in the factory, site installation needs no quality control.
If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb.

A unitized system moves most work into the factory: glazing, structural silicone curing, sealing and quality checks happen in controlled conditions, leaving only hoisting, hooking on and joint sealing for site.

quiz.explanationEn: A unitized system moves most work into the factory: glazing, structural silicone curing, sealing and quality checks happen in controlled conditions, leaving only hoisting, hooking on and joint sealing for site. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓層吊運與安裝節奏」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor logistics and installation rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：標準層周長 120 m、單元寬 1.5 m，每層 120/1.5 = 80 片；60 層共 4,800 片。若一組安裝隊每日 40 片，需 4,800/40 = 120 個工作天，每週 6 天約 20 週；若高空風速限制使有效工作日減少 25%，約需 160 個工作天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A typical floor with a 120 m perimeter and 1.5 m units needs 120/1.5 = 80 units; 60 floors need 4,800. At 40 units per day for one crew, that is 4,800/40 = 120 working days, about 20 weeks at 6 days per week; if wind limits at height cut effective working days by 25%, about 160 working days are needed. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每片單元出廠前有逐片檢查表（玻璃、矽利康、密封條、排水孔、編號），進場時再檢查運輸損傷；安裝前確認樓層暫存荷重不超過樓板允許值、吊具與單軌吊車經檢驗、風速計讀值在吊裝上限內，並由起重負責人核准當日吊裝。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each unit leaves the factory with a unit-by-unit checklist covering glass, silicone, gaskets, drainage holes and ID, and is checked again for transport damage on arrival; before installation confirm that floor storage loads are within slab capacity, that lifting gear and monorails are inspected and that the anemometer reading is within the lifting limit, with the lifting supervisor approving each day's lifts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 標準層周長 120 m、單元寬 1.5 m，每層 120/1.5 = 80 片；60 層共 4,800 片。若一組安裝隊每日 40 片，需 4,800/40 = 120 個工作天，每週 6 天約 20 週；若高空風速限制使有效工作日減少 25%，約需 160 個工作天。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A typical floor with a 120 m perimeter and 1.5 m units needs 120/1.5 = 80 units; 60 floors need 4,800. At 40 units per day for one crew, that is 4,800/40 = 120 working days, about 20 weeks at 6 days per week; if wind limits at height cut effective working days by 25%, about 160 working days are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate", which statement holds?

optionsEn: A typical floor with a 120 m perimeter and 1.5 m units needs 120/1.5 = 80 units; 60 floors need 4,800.

steps.title: 工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓層吊運與安裝節奏」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floor logistics and installation rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每片單元出廠前有逐片檢查表（玻璃、矽利康、密封條、排水孔、編號），進場時再檢查運輸損傷；安裝前確認樓層暫存荷重不超過樓板允許值、吊具與單軌吊車經檢驗、風速計讀值在吊裝上限內，並由起重負責人核准當日吊裝。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each unit leaves the factory with a unit-by-unit checklist covering glass, silicone, gaskets, drainage holes and ID, and is checked again for transport damage on arrival; before installation confirm that floor storage loads are within slab capacity, that lifting gear and monorails are inspected and that the anemometer reading is within the lifting limit, with the lifting supervisor approving each day's lifts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以 BIM 或條碼系統管理每片單元的編號、風壓區、出廠檢查與安裝位置；吊裝屬高風險作業，每日開工前確認風速、吊具與禁區，由起重負責人與帷幕牆工地主任簽認後才開始。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Manage each unit's ID, pressure zone, factory checks and installed position with BIM or barcodes; lifting is high-risk work, so every day confirm wind speed, lifting gear and exclusion zones, with the lifting supervisor and façade site manager signing before work starts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樓層暫存單元過度集中造成樓板局部超載；安裝進度與主結構相距太近，上方仍在澆置混凝土時下方單元被汙染或撞擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concentrating stored units on one bay overloads the slab locally; installing too close behind the structure lets concrete work above soil or strike new units below. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓層吊運與安裝節奏」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floor logistics and installation rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樓層暫存單元過度集中造成樓板局部超載；安裝進度與主結構相距太近，上方仍在澆置混凝土時下方單元被汙染或撞擊。單元編號錯置使不同風壓區的單元互換，角隅區裝上一般區的單元，在颱風中變形或漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrating stored units on one bay overloads the slab locally; installing too close behind the structure lets concrete work above soil or strike new units below. Mixed-up unit IDs swap units between pressure zones, so a typical-zone unit ends up at a corner and deforms or leaks in a typhoon. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：安裝高度越高，風速越大、可作業時間越短；哈里發塔官方資料即記錄其鋁與玻璃立面在 512 m 高度安裝，創下當時紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The higher the installation, the stronger the wind and the shorter the working window; Burj Khalifa's official information records the installation of its aluminium and glass façade at a height of 512 m as a record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單元式帷幕牆在工廠完成，現場安裝不需要品質管制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because units are made in the factory, site installation needs no quality control." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工廠組裝、樓層吊運與安裝節奏」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Factory assembly, floor logistics and installation rate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要每一片單元都對齊下面那一片，整面帷幕牆就一定垂直。
樓層暫存單元過度集中造成樓板局部超載；安裝進度與主結構相距太近，上方仍在澆置混凝土時下方單元被汙染或撞擊。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb.
Concentrating stored units on one bay overloads the slab locally.
quiz.explanation: 樓層暫存單元過度集中造成樓板局部超載；安裝進度與主結構相距太近，上方仍在澆置混凝土時下方單元被汙染或撞擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrating stored units on one bay overloads the slab locally; installing too close behind the structure lets concrete work above soil or strike new units below. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場測量與公差吸收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site survey and tolerance absorption: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「安裝公差預算」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Installation tolerance budget” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土主結構的樓板邊緣位置誤差常以數十毫米計，而帷幕牆單元之間的接縫只容許數毫米的偏差；兩者的落差必須由錨件調整量吸收。安裝前測量人員要依施工控制網量測每層樓板邊緣與預埋件的實際位置，帷幕牆廠商據此決定每個錨件的調整值，必要時調整特殊單元或錨件。各項誤差並非同時達到最大值，常以平方和開根號估算組合誤差，但若某一項系統性偏移（例如整棟樓扭轉）就不能用此方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「安裝公差預算」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slab-edge positions in a concrete structure deviate by tens of millimetres, while joints between curtain-wall units tolerate only a few millimetres; the difference must be absorbed by bracket adjustment. Before installation surveyors measure each floor's actual slab-edge and embed positions from the construction control network, and the façade contractor sets each bracket's adjustment from these, modifying special units or brackets where needed. Individual errors rarely peak together, so the combination is often estimated by the root sum of squares, but this method fails if one error is systematic, such as a twist of the whole building. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Installation tolerance budget” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：組合誤差 e = √(e₁² + e₂² + e₃²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Combined error e = √(e₁² + e₂² + e₃²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每一片單元都對齊下面那一片，整面帷幕牆就一定垂直。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「安裝公差預算」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Installation tolerance budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Before installation surveyors measure each floor's actual slab-edge and embed positions from the construction control network, and the façade contractor sets each bracket's adjustment from these, modifying special units or brackets where needed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每一片單元都對齊下面那一片，整面帷幕牆就一定垂直。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場測量與公差吸收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site survey and tolerance absorption" is correct?
options: 混凝土主結構的樓板邊緣位置誤差常以數十毫米計，而帷幕牆單元之間的接縫只容許數毫米的偏差；兩者的落差必須由錨件調整量吸收。

單元式帷幕牆的接縫可以滑動，因此不需要做層間位移試驗。
optionsEn: Slab-edge positions in a concrete structure deviate by tens of millimetres, while joints between curtain-wall units tolerate only a few millimetres.
If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb.
Because unitized joints can slide, no racking test is needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Slab-edge positions in a concrete structure deviate by tens of millimetres, while joints between curtain-wall units tolerate only a few millimetres; the difference must be absorbed by bracket adjustment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場測量與公差吸收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site survey and tolerance absorption: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安裝公差預算」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Installation tolerance budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：組合誤差 e = √(e₁² + e₂² + e₃²)。樓板邊緣 ±25 mm、預埋槽位置 ±10 mm、托架製作 ±5 mm：e = √(25² + 10² + 5²) = √750 ≈ 27.4 mm < 錨件進出調整量 ±30 mm；若樓板誤差增為 ±30 mm，e ≈ 31.8 mm，已超過調整量。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Combined error e = √(e₁² + e₂² + e₃²). With slab edge ±25 mm, channel position ±10 mm and bracket fabrication ±5 mm: e = √(25² + 10² + 5²) = √750 ≈ 27.4 mm, within an in–out bracket adjustment of ±30 mm; if the slab error grows to ±30 mm, e ≈ 31.8 mm, beyond the adjustment. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每層以全站儀量測樓板邊緣與預埋件座標，製作偏差圖並交帷幕牆廠商；安裝後量測單元的垂直度、平整度、接縫寬度與相鄰單元面差，記錄於逐層檢查表，與規範允收值（例如每層與累積的垂直度限值）比較，超出時由帷幕牆工程師判定調整方式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey slab-edge and embed coordinates on each floor with a total station, prepare deviation maps and pass them to the façade contractor; after installation measure plumb, flatness, joint widths and steps between adjacent units on a floor-by-floor checklist against specified limits, such as per-floor and cumulative plumb, with the façade engineer deciding how to correct exceedances.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 組合誤差 e = √(e₁² + e₂² + e₃²)。樓板邊緣 ±25 mm、預埋槽位置 ±10 mm、托架製作 ±5 mm：e = √(25² + 10² + 5²) = √750 ≈ 27.4 mm < 錨件進出調整量 ±30 mm；若樓板誤差增為 ±30 mm，e ≈ 31.8 mm，已超過調整量。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Combined error e = √(e₁² + e₂² + e₃²). With slab edge ±25 mm, channel position ±10 mm and bracket fabrication ±5 mm: e = √(25² + 10² + 5²) = √750 ≈ 27.4 mm, within an in–out bracket adjustment of ±30 mm; if the slab error grows to ±30 mm, e ≈ 31.8 mm, beyond the adjustment. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場測量與公差吸收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。

steps.title: 現場測量與公差吸收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site survey and tolerance absorption: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安裝公差預算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Installation tolerance budget” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每層以全站儀量測樓板邊緣與預埋件座標，製作偏差圖並交帷幕牆廠商；安裝後量測單元的垂直度、平整度、接縫寬度與相鄰單元面差，記錄於逐層檢查表，與規範允收值（例如每層與累積的垂直度限值）比較，超出時由帷幕牆工程師判定調整方式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey slab-edge and embed coordinates on each floor with a total station, prepare deviation maps and pass them to the façade contractor; after installation measure plumb, flatness, joint widths and steps between adjacent units on a floor-by-floor checklist against specified limits, such as per-floor and cumulative plumb, with the façade engineer deciding how to correct exceedances. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：測量控制線由主結構控制網引出並定期複測，帷幕牆每隔數層以控制線重新歸零，不得逐層累積；樓板偏差超過錨件調整量時，須先由結構與帷幕牆雙方會勘決定處理方式，再繼續安裝。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Derive façade control lines from the main structure's control network and re-survey them regularly, resetting the façade to the lines every few floors rather than accumulating errors; where slab deviation exceeds bracket adjustment, both structural and façade teams must inspect and agree the remedy before installation continues.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未事先量測樓板邊緣就開始安裝，到中途才發現某些樓層偏差超過錨件調整量，只好現場改造托架或切割單元，破壞防水與防蝕；以每層各自對齊而非對準控制線，垂直誤差逐層累積，高處立面明顯歪斜。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Starting installation without surveying the slab edges reveals midway that some floors exceed the bracket range, forcing site modification of brackets or cutting of units that damages waterproofing and corrosion protection; aligning each floor to the one below instead of to control lines lets plumb errors accumulate until the upper façade visibly leans. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 現場測量與公差吸收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site survey and tolerance absorption: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安裝公差預算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Installation tolerance budget” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未事先量測樓板邊緣就開始安裝，到中途才發現某些樓層偏差超過錨件調整量，只好現場改造托架或切割單元，破壞防水與防蝕；以每層各自對齊而非對準控制線，垂直誤差逐層累積，高處立面明顯歪斜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Starting installation without surveying the slab edges reveals midway that some floors exceed the bracket range, forcing site modification of brackets or cutting of units that damages waterproofing and corrosion protection; aligning each floor to the one below instead of to control lines lets plumb errors accumulate until the upper façade visibly leans. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：各項誤差並非同時達到最大值，常以平方和開根號估算組合誤差，但若某一項系統性偏移（例如整棟樓扭轉）就不能用此方法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Individual errors rarely peak together, so the combination is often estimated by the root sum of squares, but this method fails if one error is systematic, such as a twist of the whole building.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每一片單元都對齊下面那一片，整面帷幕牆就一定垂直。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If each unit lines up with the one below it, the whole wall is bound to be plumb." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場測量與公差吸收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site survey and tolerance absorption" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」與「錨件鎖固、防鬆與逐層驗收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Performance mock-up and racking test" and "Anchor tightening, locking and floor-by-floor acceptance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Performance mock-up and racking test: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「性能樣品牆層間位移試驗」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mock-up racking test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 量產前，帷幕牆廠商會在試驗室以實尺寸、至少兩層樓高的性能樣品牆，依序進行氣密、水密、結構與層間位移等試驗。對單元式系統而言，最關鍵的往往是層間位移試驗：試驗架把上下樓層的模擬樓板相對水平推移，檢查上下單元接縫與公母豎框能否滑動而不脫開、玻璃不破、密封不失效，並在位移後重做水密試驗。樣品牆應包含角隅、上下單元接縫與典型錨件，才能代表真實立面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「性能樣品牆層間位移試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before production the façade contractor tests a full-size performance mock-up, at least two storeys high, in a laboratory in sequence for air, water, structural and racking performance. For unitized systems the racking test is often the most critical: the rig moves the simulated floors above and below horizontally relative to each other to check that stack joints and split mullions slide without disengaging, glass does not break and seals keep working, with the water test repeated after the movement. The mock-up must include a corner, stack joints and typical anchors to represent the real façade. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mock-up racking test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設計層間變位角 0.5%，層高 4.2 m：Δ = 0.005×4,200 = 21 mm；試驗取 1.5 倍為 31.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a design drift ratio of 0.5% and a 4.2 m storey, Δ = 0.005×4,200 = 21 mm; the test uses 1.5 times, 31.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單元式帷幕牆的接縫可以滑動，因此不需要做層間位移試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because unitized joints can slide, no racking test is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「性能樣品牆層間位移試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mock-up racking test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

For unitized systems the racking test is often the most critical: the rig moves the simulated floors above and below horizontally relative to each other to check that stack joints and split mullions slide without disengaging, glass does not break and seals keep working, with the water test repeated after the movement.

knowledge.text: 誤解：單元式帷幕牆的接縫可以滑動，因此不需要做層間位移試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Performance mock-up and racking test: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「性能樣品牆層間位移試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mock-up racking test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設計層間變位角 0.5%，層高 4.2 m：Δ = 0.005×4,200 = 21 mm；試驗取 1.5 倍為 31.5 mm。若接縫插接深度 40 mm、單元寬 1.5 m 在 31.5 mm 位移下的轉角 θ ≈ 31.5/4,200 ≈ 0.0075 rad，插接處水平滑移需求約 31.5 mm，仍小於 40 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a design drift ratio of 0.5% and a 4.2 m storey, Δ = 0.005×4,200 = 21 mm; the test uses 1.5 times, 31.5 mm. With a 40 mm interlock and 1.5 m units, the rotation at 31.5 mm is θ ≈ 31.5/4,200 ≈ 0.0075 rad and the sliding demand at the interlock is about 31.5 mm, still below 40 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫依 AAMA 501.4 或專案規範訂定位移值、循環次數與允收準則（無脫落、無玻璃破裂、位移後水密合格、殘餘變形在限值內），並由業主的帷幕牆顧問到場見證；試驗後拆解樣品，檢查錨件、密封條與插接處的磨損。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set displacement values, cycles and acceptance criteria (no fallout, no glass breakage, water test passed after movement, residual deformation within limits) per AAMA 501.4 or the project specification, witnessed by the owner's façade consultant; after the test dismantle the specimen and inspect anchors, gaskets and interlocks for wear.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：扭力與預壓 T = K·F·d。取扭矩係數 K = 0.2、目標預壓 F = 20 kN、M12 螺栓 d = 0.012 m：T = 0.2×20,000×0.012 = 48 N·m。若螺紋乾燥使 K 升為 0.3，同樣 48 N·m 只得到 F = 48/(0.3×0.012) ≈ 13.3 kN，約為目標的 67%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Torque and preload T = K·F·d. With nut factor K = 0.2, target preload F = 20 kN and an M12 bolt with d = 0.012 m: T = 0.2×20,000×0.012 = 48 N·m. If dry threads raise K to 0.3, the same 48 N·m gives only F = 48/(0.3×0.012) ≈ 13.3 kN, about 67% of the target. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校正過的扭力扳手鎖固並抽樣複驗，在螺栓與托架上做防鬆標記；逐層檢查表記錄每個錨件的調整值、扭力、防鬆措施、固定或滑動屬性與絕緣墊片，並拍照，由帷幕牆工程師與監造共同簽認後才拆除該層的安裝通道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tighten with calibrated torque wrenches and re-check a sample, marking bolts and brackets to show any loosening; the floor checklist records each bracket's adjustment, torque, locking measure, fixed or sliding designation and isolating pad, with photographs, signed jointly by the façade engineer and supervising engineer before that floor's installation access is removed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「錨件鎖固、防鬆與逐層驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

If an aluminium mullion's stress is below the allowable value, its deflection need not be checked.

steps.title: 錨件鎖固、防鬆與逐層驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anchor tightening, locking and floor-by-floor acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨件螺栓預壓與紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor bolt preload and records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以校正過的扭力扳手鎖固並抽樣複驗，在螺栓與托架上做防鬆標記；逐層檢查表記錄每個錨件的調整值、扭力、防鬆措施、固定或滑動屬性與絕緣墊片，並拍照，由帷幕牆工程師與監造共同簽認後才拆除該層的安裝通道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tighten with calibrated torque wrenches and re-check a sample, marking bolts and brackets to show any loosening; the floor checklist records each bracket's adjustment, torque, locking measure, fixed or sliding designation and isolating pad, with photographs, signed jointly by the façade engineer and supervising engineer before that floor's installation access is removed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：錨件圖應以符號清楚區分固定點與滑動點，並規定螺栓等級、扭力、潤滑狀態與防鬆方式；逐層錨件驗收是封閉安裝通道前的停止點，未簽認的樓層不得拆除臨時工作平台。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bracket drawings must clearly mark fixed and sliding points by symbol and state bolt grade, torque, lubrication condition and locking method; floor-by-floor bracket acceptance is a hold point before installation access closes, and temporary work platforms on an unsigned floor may not be removed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：趕工時只用手鎖或漏裝止動件，數年後錨件在風壓循環下滑移，單元下沉並把上下接縫擠閉；把應滑動的錨件鎖死，夏季高溫時鋁框伸長無處釋放，造成接縫密封剪壞與異音。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Hand-tightening under time pressure or omitting stops lets brackets slip under cyclic wind over the years, so units drop and close the stack joints; locking a bracket that should slide leaves summer expansion nowhere to go, shearing joint seals and causing creaking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨件鎖固、防鬆與逐層驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 錨件鎖固、防鬆與逐層驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Anchor tightening, locking and floor-by-floor acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨件螺栓預壓與紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchor bolt preload and records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 趕工時只用手鎖或漏裝止動件，數年後錨件在風壓循環下滑移，單元下沉並把上下接縫擠閉；把應滑動的錨件鎖死，夏季高溫時鋁框伸長無處釋放，造成接縫密封剪壞與異音。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Hand-tightening under time pressure or omitting stops lets brackets slip under cyclic wind over the years, so units drop and close the stack joints; locking a bracket that should slide leaves summer expansion nowhere to go, shearing joint seals and causing creaking. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：逐層驗收的目的，是在上方樓層封閉施工通道前，確認每個錨件都按設計鎖固、每條接縫都正確插接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Floor-by-floor acceptance confirms, before access from the floor above is closed off, that every bracket is locked as designed and every joint correctly interlocked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨件螺栓只要鎖緊，扭力值高低並不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as bracket bolts are tight, the torque value does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「錨件鎖固、防鬆與逐層驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Anchor tightening, locking and floor-by-floor acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。
趕工時只用手鎖或漏裝止動件，數年後錨件在風壓循環下滑移，單元下沉並把上下接縫擠閉；把應滑動的錨件鎖死，夏季高溫時鋁框伸長無處釋放，造成接縫密封剪壞與異音。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
When a curtain wall leaks, sealing every gap with more sealant solves the problem.
Hand-tightening under time pressure or omitting stops lets brackets slip under cyclic wind over the years, so units drop and close the stack joints.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制」與「維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation" and "Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斷熱條與內表面溫度」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal break and inner surface temperature” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 單元式帷幕牆的耐久與舒適，取決於三個看不見的系統：鋁框中的斷熱條阻斷熱橋，避免室內側框料過冷結露；外層密封與內層氣密之間的等壓腔體，讓滲入的少量雨水在壓差很小的情況下由排水孔排出；層間板背後的防火與防潮層則避免水汽在牆內凝結。若室內側框料表面溫度低於室內空氣的露點，冬季就會結露、滴水並使框料與密封長期受潮。等壓與排水路徑若被密封膠堵住，原本安全的雨水就會被困在單元內。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斷熱條與內表面溫度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The durability and comfort of a unitized wall depend on three hidden systems: polyamide thermal breaks in the aluminium cut thermal bridges so inner frames do not get cold enough to condense; a pressure-equalised cavity between the outer seal and the inner air seal lets the small amount of water that enters drain through weep holes under a very small pressure difference; and fire and vapour layers behind spandrels stop moisture condensing inside the wall. If the inner frame surface falls below the dew point of room air, winter condensation drips and keeps frames and seals wet; if sealant blocks the drainage and equalisation paths, otherwise harmless rain is trapped inside the unit. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Thermal break and inner surface temperature” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：內表面溫度 T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Inner surface temperature T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When a curtain wall leaks, sealing every gap with more sealant solves the problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
