帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。
單元式帷幕牆的玻璃壞了，只要從室內拆下重裝即可，不需要外牆維護設備。
optionsEn: The durability and comfort of a unitized wall depend on three hidden systems: polyamide thermal breaks in the aluminium cut thermal bridges so inner frames do not get cold enough to condense.
When a curtain wall leaks, sealing every gap with more sealant solves the problem.
If a unitized pane breaks, it can simply be replaced from inside without any external access equipment.
quiz.explanation: 單元式帷幕牆的耐久與舒適，取決於三個看不見的系統：鋁框中的斷熱條阻斷熱橋，避免室內側框料過冷結露；外層密封與內層氣密之間的等壓腔體，讓滲入的少量雨水在壓差很小的情況下由排水孔排出；層間板背後的防火與防潮層則避免水汽在牆內凝結。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The durability and comfort of a unitized wall depend on three hidden systems: polyamide thermal breaks in the aluminium cut thermal bridges so inner frames do not get cold enough to condense; a pressure-equalised cavity between the outer seal and the inner air seal lets the small amount of water that enters drain through weep holes under a very small pressure difference; and fire and vapour layers behind spandrels stop moisture condensing inside the wall. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷熱條與內表面溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal break and inner surface temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：內表面溫度 T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total。T_i = 21°C、T_o = −5°C、R_si = 0.13 m²K/W、框料 U = 3.0 W/m²K（R_total ≈ 0.333）：T_si = 21 − 26×0.13/0.333 ≈ 10.9°C；室內 21°C、相對濕度 50% 的露點約 10.2°C，餘裕僅約 0.7 K。U 改善為 2.0 時 T_si ≈ 14.2°C。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Inner surface temperature T_si = T_i − (T_i − T_o)·R_si/R_total. With T_i = 21°C, T_o = −5°C, R_si = 0.13 m²K/W and a frame U = 3.0 W/m²K (R_total ≈ 0.333): T_si = 21 − 26×0.13/0.333 ≈ 10.9°C; the dew point of room air at 21°C and 50% relative humidity is about 10.2°C, a margin of only about 0.7 K. Improving U to 2.0 gives T_si ≈ 14.2°C. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以二維熱傳模擬（如 ISO 10211 方法）計算框料內表面最低溫度與溫度係數，與室內設計溫濕度的露點比較；在樣品牆與現場檢查排水孔是否暢通、等壓腔體是否被多餘密封膠堵塞，必要時以紅外線熱像儀在冬季找出熱橋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate the minimum inner-frame surface temperature and temperature factor with two-dimensional heat-transfer modelling, for example by ISO 10211 methods, and compare with the dew point of the indoor design condition; on the mock-up and on site check that weep holes are clear and that pressure-equalised cavities are not blocked by excess sealant, and use infrared thermography in winter to find thermal bridges where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷熱條與內表面溫度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal break and inner surface temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以二維熱傳模擬（如 ISO 10211 方法）計算框料內表面最低溫度與溫度係數，與室內設計溫濕度的露點比較；在樣品牆與現場檢查排水孔是否暢通、等壓腔體是否被多餘密封膠堵塞，必要時以紅外線熱像儀在冬季找出熱橋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate the minimum inner-frame surface temperature and temperature factor with two-dimensional heat-transfer modelling, for example by ISO 10211 methods, and compare with the dew point of the indoor design condition; on the mock-up and on site check that weep holes are clear and that pressure-equalised cavities are not blocked by excess sealant, and use infrared thermography in winter to find thermal bridges where needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工說明中標示所有不得填塞的排水孔與等壓通道，並禁止現場未經核准的補打密封；維修單位在處理漏水前，須先由帷幕牆顧問判斷水的路徑，而非直接封閉。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark on the installation drawings every weep hole and equalisation path that must stay open and prohibit unapproved site sealing; before treating a leak, maintenance staff must have the façade consultant trace the water path instead of simply sealing over it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了省成本取消斷熱條或以金屬螺絲穿過斷熱層，寒流時室內框料結露滴水，長期造成內裝發霉與密封膠脫黏；現場補打密封膠堵住排水孔，雨水在單元底部累積，最後從室內側溢出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting thermal breaks to save cost, or driving metal screws through them, lets inner frames condense and drip in cold spells, causing mould in finishes and debonded seals over time; sealant added on site that blocks weep holes lets rainwater collect in the bottom of units until it spills indoors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 斷熱、等壓排水與結露控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal breaks, pressure-equalised drainage and condensation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷熱條與內表面溫度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal break and inner surface temperature” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了省成本取消斷熱條或以金屬螺絲穿過斷熱層，寒流時室內框料結露滴水，長期造成內裝發霉與密封膠脫黏；現場補打密封膠堵住排水孔，雨水在單元底部累積，最後從室內側溢出。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting thermal breaks to save cost, or driving metal screws through them, lets inner frames condense and drip in cold spells, causing mould in finishes and debonded seals over time; sealant added on site that blocks weep holes lets rainwater collect in the bottom of units until it spills indoors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：等壓與排水路徑若被密封膠堵住，原本安全的雨水就會被困在單元內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If the inner frame surface falls below the dew point of room air, winter condensation drips and keeps frames and seals wet; if sealant blocks the drainage and equalisation paths, otherwise harmless rain is trapped inside the unit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆漏水時，多打一層密封膠把所有縫封死就能解決。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When a curtain wall leaks, sealing every gap with more sealant solves the problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」如何影響單元式帷幕牆安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BMU access and replacement records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Unitized curtain-wall installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超高層帷幕牆完工後仍需數十年的清洗、檢查、密封更新與玻璃更換，這些都依賴外牆維護吊車（BMU）的軌道、吊臂伸距與固定點。單元式系統的玻璃多以結構矽利康固定在框上，更換時常需從外側以 BMU 吊運新玻璃，或在室內拆下整片單元，因此設計時就要確認 BMU 能到達每一片單元、吊運能力足以處理最大玻璃。CTBUH 資料中哈里發塔另列有外牆維護顧問，顯示超高層維護規劃是獨立的專業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After completion a supertall curtain wall still needs decades of cleaning, inspection, seal renewal and glass replacement, all depending on the building maintenance unit (BMU) tracks, jib reach and restraint points. In unitized systems glass is often structurally siliconed to the frame, so replacement usually means lifting new glass from outside with the BMU or removing a whole unit from inside, and the design must confirm that the BMU can reach every unit and lift the largest pane. The CTBUH record for Burj Khalifa separately lists a façade-maintenance consultant, showing that supertall maintenance planning is a specialism of its own. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “BMU access and replacement records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：立面面積 = 周長 120 m × 60 層 × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²；兩台 BMU 每台每日清洗 600 m²，一輪約 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 天。

steps.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Maintenance access, unit replacement and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BMU access and replacement records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：立面面積 = 周長 120 m × 60 層 × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²；兩台 BMU 每台每日清洗 600 m²，一輪約 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 天。若單元年更換率 0.2%，4,800 片每年約 9.6 片，建議常備約 10 片典型尺寸玻璃與密封材。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Façade area = 120 m perimeter × 60 floors × 4.2 m = 30,240 m²; with two BMUs cleaning 600 m² per day each, one cycle takes about 30,240/(2×600) ≈ 25.2 days. With an annual replacement rate of 0.2%, 4,800 units need about 9.6 replacements per year, so about 10 typical-size panes and seal kits should be kept in stock. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前以實際操作確認 BMU 能到達最難接近的角隅與退縮處，並以最大玻璃尺寸做吊運演練；定期檢查計畫包含密封膠硬度與附著抽驗、排水孔清理、錨件抽樣檢查與漏水紀錄分析，結果與竣工基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover demonstrate that the BMU reaches the most difficult corners and setbacks, and rehearse lifting the largest glass size; the periodic inspection plan includes sealant hardness and adhesion sampling, weep-hole cleaning, sample bracket checks and analysis of leak records, compared with the completion baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 維護吊車、單元更換與竣工交接：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外牆維護吊車與更換紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “BMU access and replacement records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前以實際操作確認 BMU 能到達最難接近的角隅與退縮處，並以最大玻璃尺寸做吊運演練；定期檢查計畫包含密封膠硬度與附著抽驗、排水孔清理、錨件抽樣檢查與漏水紀錄分析，結果與竣工基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover demonstrate that the BMU reaches the most difficult corners and setbacks, and rehearse lifting the largest glass size; the periodic inspection plan includes sealant hardness and adhesion sampling, weep-hole cleaning, sample bracket checks and analysis of leak records, compared with the completion baseline. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Completion documents should include the unit ID map, glass and profile specifications for each unit, bracket and joint details, test reports, BMU operating and lifting procedures, spares list and warranties; before any façade alteration or added signage, the façade consultant must assess the effect on brackets and waterproofing and the owner must approve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：BMU 吊臂伸距不足以到達退縮樓層的立面，某片玻璃破裂後只能搭設昂貴的臨時吊架；交接時沒有留下單元編號與玻璃規格對照，更換時訂錯鍍膜或尺寸，色差與漏水問題接踵而來。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A BMU jib too short to reach façades at setback floors means a single broken pane needs costly temporary rigging; without a record linking unit IDs to glass specifications at handover, replacements arrive with the wrong coating or size, bringing colour mismatch and leaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
